query.armRunEndCeiling.reason: ceiling is armed for every turn

query.endRun.reason: run-end settlement is observed by the driver

query.initializeWritten.gate.note: the initialize-written promise and its resolver
query.initializeWritten.gate.reason: streamInput awaits it before the first write; resolved by the first initialize

query.processControlRequest.can_use_tool.note: the native permission request the callback answers
query.processControlRequest.can_use_tool.reason: canUseTool is set, so the SDK answers a native can_use_tool request here

query.promptHold.assignment.note: the only assignment site of promptHold
query.promptHold.assignment.reason: assigned only under hasHookSetToBlock(), which hooks:{} cannot satisfy

query.streamInput.note: the selected input path for this route
query.streamInput.reason: iterable prompt is written through streamInput

query.writeBehindPromptHold.note: the hold barrier every prompt-hold branch funnels through
query.writeBehindPromptHold.reason: every call site is gated on promptHold being defined

query.writePrompt.note: string-prompt write path; not selected by an iterable prompt
query.writePrompt.reason: string-prompt only; the sidecar passes an async iterable

settings.managed_projection.note: restrictive managed-policy projection of the parent tier
settings.managed_projection.reason: the parent tier is empty for this route, but the native reads its own administrator tier, so managed policy is not excluded by these bytes

settings.resolve.sources.note: how settingSources and Options.managedSettings become tiers
settings.resolve.sources.reason: settingSources maps only user, project and local; the administrator tier is not one of them

settings.restrictive_key_table.reason: the key is a managed-policy key; honor and bypass behavior are native

telemetry.key_sanitizer_function.note: the gated recursive key sanitizer added at 0.3.321
telemetry.key_sanitizer_function.reason: its callers are the tag and custom-title writes, not the turn path

telemetry.key_sanitizer_legacy.note: the ungated sanitizer the earlier hops carry
telemetry.key_sanitizer_legacy.reason: its callers are the tag and custom-title writes, not the turn path

telemetry.limits_gate.note: telemetry limits gate the sanitizer consults
telemetry.limits_gate.reason: only consulted from the sanitizer gate

telemetry.numeric_key_test.note: numeric-key predicate used by the sanitizer gate
telemetry.numeric_key_test.reason: only consulted from the sanitizer gate

telemetry.sanitizer_gate.note: the telemetry-gated numeric-key condition inside the sanitizer
telemetry.sanitizer_gate.reason: only consulted from the sanitizer, whose callers are control-path writes

transport.argv.await_initialize_gate.note: the gate that keeps --await-initialize off this route
transport.argv.await_initialize_gate.reason: requires both pathToClaudeCodeExecutable and spawnClaudeCodeProcess to be unset

transport.argv.base.reason: every native spawn uses this argv

transport.argv.managed_settings.note: SDK-option parent tier on the native argv
transport.argv.managed_settings.reason: emitted only for Options.managedSettings, which the sidecar never sets

reachability_inputs.env: explicit child environment, never the inherited process environment
reachability_inputs.hooks: {} (nothing sets onFailure, so hasHookSetToBlock() is false)
reachability_inputs.prompt: async iterable, so streamInput is the selected input path
reachability_inputs.settingSources: [] (user, project and local disk tiers disabled)
